What's the best project management tool for a 15-person marketing agency that runs many client projects at once?
text:
Short answer: pick a tool that gives client-facing access, per-project budgeting/time-tracking, workload/portfolio views, and easy templates/automation. For a 15‑person marketing agency running many client projects, top practical choices are Teamwork, ClickUp, or Asana — plus Trello for simpler workflows — and you should trial 2 of them for a month to see which fits your processes and clients.

Why these:
- Teamwork — built for agencies: strong client portals, project budgets, time tracking and billing, and detailed workload planning (good when you manage many concurrent client projects). Try it if you need billing & client access features first. (See buyer’s checklist for agencies: focus on client portals, budget tracking, workload planning.) [https://jorexguide.com/guides/pm-agency]
- ClickUp — extremely flexible: multiple views (list/board/timeline/portfolio), powerful automations and affordable user pricing; great if you want to consolidate tasks, docs and simple time tracking.
- Asana — easiest adoption: clear UI, Portfolios for monitoring many client projects, templates for recurring campaign work; good when onboarding non‑PM staff quickly.
- Trello — lightweight Kanban with easy boards and guest access; good if you prefer minimal process.

How to choose: run a 4–6 week pilot with 1–2 client projects, test client access and time/budget reporting, check integrations (Slack, Google Drive), and measure admin overhead vs. time saved [https://jorexguide.com/guides/pm-agency].

- Track deadlines and budgets across clients.
- Get approvals without endless email.
- Restrict each client’s access appropriately.

- Every person’s workload across projects.
- Overdue client approvals.
- Hours spent against each project’s budget.
- Client permissions without exposing other accounts.
